name: Hiba Bango
source: A sophomore at Kototoi Academy. A boy who lives on his own because his parents and grandfather died in an accident last year. He is however looking for his [url=/c87388]older brother[/url] who went missing several years ago. Has a cold and stiff appearance, but can easily become aggressive and angered, which is when Bango shows his sadistic side. He can see others' feelings and spot lies in colors. However, his ability has a price: the more he uses it, the harder it becomes for him to suppress his sexual urges.
